slides.label: Verse 1
lines: <b><s1384>In Your presence fills the air
I see miracles everywhere
In Your presence is healing, wellness, and wholeness
You’re the answer to life’s weary questions

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: <b><s1384>Spirit of comfort, Spirit of love
Spirit of God, the absolute solution
To everything, to everything

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: <b><s1384>Dear Holy Spirit, Author of creation
You’re heaven’s beauty
And the glory of the earth

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: <b><s1384>The glory of Your presence
Is the glamour of my life
Lord, You’re the Father who lives in me
